sweeps.label: Elbow flare at 80 kg
sweeps.description: Upper-arm angle from the torso at the touch: 90° is flared out, 45° is tucked toward the feet.

sweeps.label: Grip width at 80 kg
sweeps.description: Palm distance from the bar centre and its effect on shoulder and elbow demands (0.405 m is the competition maximum).

sweeps.label: Load
sweeps.description: Peak shoulder and elbow demands of a flat bench press as the bar gets heavier (grip half-width 0.40 m, elbows at 60°).

sweeps.label: Touch point at 80 kg
sweeps.description: Where the bar touches along the body, from the lower-chest reference toward the feet.

sweeps.label: Hip timing at 150 kg
sweeps.description: Trunk-extension timing exponent: low values extend the trunk early (upright pull), high values keep it inclined until late (hips shoot up).

sweeps.label: Load
sweeps.description: Peak hip, knee, ankle, and lumbar demands of a conventional deadlift as the bar gets heavier (start knee 80°).

sweeps.label: Start position (knee angle) at 150 kg
sweeps.description: Hips-high versus hips-low setups: knee flexion in the start position for a 150 kg conventional deadlift.

sweeps.label: Tempo at 150 kg
sweeps.description: Faster or slower pull/lowering (multiplier on the reference 1.8 s pull and 1.3 s lowering) and the resulting peak demands and ground reaction.

sweeps.label: Depth (peak knee flexion) at 100 kg
sweeps.description: How hip, knee, ankle, and lumbar demands change with squat depth for a 100 kg low-bar and high-bar squat.

sweeps.label: Load × bar placement
sweeps.description: Peak net joint demands as the bar gets heavier, for low-bar and high-bar placement at each placement's reference depth and trunk lean.

sweeps.label: Tempo at 100 kg low-bar
sweeps.description: Slower or faster descent/ascent (multiplier on the reference 1.6 s descent and 1.4 s ascent) and its effect on peak demands and ground reaction.

sweeps.label: Trunk lean at 100 kg low-bar
sweeps.description: Trading hip for knee demand: peak trunk inclination at the bottom of a 100 kg low-bar squat at fixed depth.
